performance.assessment: No material integrated overhead observed in these matched samples. Full CLI paired medians are within 1% of baseline; AFD preparation paired medians are 0.95-0.99x. Native replay timer shows wider variation and is reported separately; no formal statistical non-regression gate is claimed.

timing_boundaries.compile_ms: Python compiler only; each input is validated before this timer
timing_boundaries.zero_request_preparation_ms: compile + zero-request native preparation, including model construction and memory preflight
timing_boundaries.cli_ms: fresh supervised CLI, startup + compilation + model construction + replay + output
timing_boundaries.native_replay_ms: Replayer::run_inner through collector finalization; excludes model construction, Python startup and output; not loop-only timing

performance.sample_design: two warmups per arm; seven alternating adjacent pairs; same host, dependencies, data, release flags and verified runtime hashes; no builds/tests during sampling
performance.cost_bound: Fabric resolved once per model. Prepared rank mapping queries are O(1); homogeneous mapping retains no vector allocation. Nonuniform mapping retains 16*TP bytes of coefficients and prepares O(TP*F_node_width) temporary counts, independent of requests/layers/A-node count.

goldens.qualification_fixture_changed: schema 6, explicit F width, receiver-map label and resulting replay hash

limits: Cross-rack A/F pricing uses the conservative whole-pair span, not actual rack-layout traffic fractions.
AFD support remains SGLang / supported routed MoE / pure F EP; no new backend, dense, routing or deployment support.
Host timings are descriptive on macOS without CPU affinity; no long-corpus Mooncake campaign, hardware serving-accuracy validation or loop-only timing is claimed.
